test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION {src} SELECT CounterID, AdvEngineID, URL, SearchPhrase FROM hits_10m_single SETTINGS s3_truncate_on_insert = 1, max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, output_format_parquet_parallel_encoding = 0, output_format_parquet_row_group_size = 250000
SELECT throwIf(num_rows != 10000000 OR num_row_groups NOT BETWEEN 30 AND 50) FROM s3(perf_s3, filename = 'parquet_s3_single_object/hits.parquet', format = ParquetMetadata)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM {src} WHERE URL LIKE '%google%' FORMAT Null
SELECT SearchPhrase, min(URL), count() AS c FROM {src} WHERE URL LIKE '%google%' AND SearchPhrase != '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT CounterID, avg(length(URL)) AS l FROM {src} WHERE URL != '' GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY l DESC LIMIT 25 FORMAT Null
SELECT count() FROM {src} WHERE AdvEngineID != 0 FORMAT Null
